title: Hot chocolate / cocoa, dry mix, made with water

content.title: About
content.content: The dry mix for hot chocolate is a blend of cocoa powder, sugar, and flavorings. When mixed with hot water it yields a rich, aromatic beverage that is quick to prepare and does not require milk.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The mix often contains a small amount of emulsifiers to keep the drink smooth and free of sediment.
Cocoa powder in dry mixes is usually roasted at low temperatures to preserve volatile aroma compounds.
In some countries hot chocolate is spiced with cinnamon or vanilla for a more complex flavor.
Dry mixes are convenient for travel and camping – just add boiling water.
Cocoa is rich in flavonoids, which have antioxidant properties.

items.title: Rich in flavonoids
items.content: Flavonoids help improve vascular function and act as antioxidants.

items.title: Mood support
items.content: Cocoa contains theobromine and small amounts of caffeine, which can boost alertness and improve mood.

items.title: Source of minerals
items.content: The mix provides magnesium, iron, and potassium, important for muscle and nerve function.

items.title: Cognitive benefits
items.content: Moderate regular consumption of cocoa has been linked to better memory and concentration.

items.title: Easy portion control
items.content: Because the drink is made from a measured dry mix, sugar and calorie intake can be easily regulated.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Most dry mixes contain added sugar, which can be an issue for people with diabetes or those watching their weight.

items.title: Cocoa allergy
items.content: A small number of individuals may experience allergic reactions to cocoa or added flavorings.

items.title: Caffeine and theobromine
items.content: Although present in low amounts, sensitive individuals may experience insomnia or rapid heartbeat.

items.title: Acidity
items.content: Cocoa can increase stomach acidity, so people with gastritis should consume it in moderation.

content.title: How to Prepare
content.content: Dissolve 2‑3 tablespoons of the dry mix in 200‑250 ml of hot (but not boiling) water, stirring until smooth. Optionally add milk, cream, or a sweetener.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the dry mix in a sealed container in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Discard if clumps form or the product develops an off‑odor.
